title: OpenAI says Apple lawsuit is attempt to 'make up for its shortcomings'
excerpt: OpenAI said Apple's lawsuit accusing it of stealing trade secrets was an attempt to make up for its "shortcomings in the market for talent."
content_html:
OpenAI is turning up the sass on Apple.

The ChatGPT maker said in a court filing this week that Apple's lawsuit accusing it of stealing trade secrets amounted to sour grapes after it fell behind in the AI talent war.

"Apple should not be permitted to use a baseless and pretextual lawsuit to make up for its shortcomings in the market for talent and retaining its employees," OpenAI said in the filing, in which it asks a judge to dismiss Apple's suit.

Big Tech companies have fought each other for talent over the last couple of years, offering staggering wages and other benefits in efforts to poach a limited pool of top engineers from rivals.

Meta, for example, has managed to steal some of OpenAI's top researchers. It lured Shengjia Zhao, the cocreator of ChatGPT, last year. Meta also hired away Alexandr Wang to lead its superintelligence team by buying the company he started, Scale AI, for $15 billion.

In its lawsuit, Apple said the total number of Apple alums now working at OpenAI exceeds 400.

Apple sued OpenAI in July, alleging the ChatGPT maker benefited from trade secrets stolen by former Apple employees hired away by OpenAI. The lawsuit alleges, among other things, that Chang Liu, a veteran Apple engineer, improperly retained and accessed confidential company information after leaving for the AI lab in January.

In OpenAI's latest filing, the company said it's common practice to recruit top talent from Apple and other companies.

"OpenAI does have an interest in hiring the best engineers, inventors, developers and creators — many of whom have decided to leave Apple and to come to OpenAI, attracted by the innovative and exciting work the company is doing," the AI startup said in the filing.

An Apple spokesperson told Business Insider in a statement Thursday that "significant evidence has emerged suggesting individuals employed by OpenAI wrongfully took Apple's secret and confidential information regarding our unreleased technologies."

Apple has not yet filed a response in court to OpenAI's filing, and a judge has not ruled on the request for a dismissal. In a blog post on Monday, OpenAI said, "We do not have, nor want, any of their trade secrets."

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 对苹果发起了攻击。

ChatGPT 制造商在本周提交的一份法庭文件中表示，苹果在人工智能人才争夺战中落后后，指控其窃取商业机密的诉讼无异于吃不到葡萄酸。

OpenAI 在文件中表示：“不应允许苹果公司利用毫无根据和借口的诉讼来弥补其在人才市场上的缺陷并留住员工。”该公司在文件中请求法官驳回苹果公司的诉讼。

过去几年，大型科技公司为了争夺人才而互相争夺，提供高得惊人的工资和其他福利，试图从竞争对手那里挖走数量有限的顶尖工程师。

例如，Meta 就成功挖走了 OpenAI 的一些顶尖研究人员。 去年，它吸引了 ChatGPT 的联合创始人赵盛嘉。 Meta 还以 150 亿美元收购了 Alexandr Wang 创办的公司 Scale AI，聘请了 Alexandr Wang 来领导其超级智能团队。

苹果在诉讼中表示，目前在 OpenAI 工作的苹果员工总数超过 400 人。

苹果于 7 月起诉 OpenAI，指控 ChatGPT 制造商从被 OpenAI 挖走的前苹果员工窃取的商业机密中获益。 该诉讼称，苹果资深工程师刘畅在一月份离开人工智能实验室后，不当保留和访问了公司机密信息。

在 OpenAI 的最新文件中，该公司表示，从苹果和其他公司招聘顶尖人才是常见做法。

这家人工智能初创公司在文件中表示：“OpenAI 确实有兴趣聘请最优秀的工程师、发明家、开发人员和创作者，其中许多人被公司正在进行的创新和令人兴奋的工作所吸引，决定离开苹果并来到 OpenAI。”

苹果发言人在周四的一份声明中告诉《商业内幕》，“有重大证据表明 OpenAI 雇用的个人错误地获取了苹果有关我们未发布技术的秘密和机密信息。”

苹果尚未对 OpenAI 的申请向法庭做出回应，法官也尚未就驳回请求做出裁决。 OpenAI 在周一的博客文章中表示，“我们没有、也不想要他们的任何商业秘密。”
